statement: The attained finite GED shape and scale are almost everywhere unique at held mean.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
(w : Fin n → ℕ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (m : ℝ)
    (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    ∀ᵐ x : Fin n → ℝ ∂volume, ∀ p q : ℝ × ℝ,
      p ∈ Ici 1 ×ˢ Ioi 0 → q ∈ Ici 1 ×ˢ Ioi 0 →
      IsMaxOn (fun r ↦ logLik w m r x) (Ici 1 ×ˢ Ioi 0) p →
      IsMaxOn (fun r ↦ logLik w m r x) (Ici 1 ×ˢ Ioi 0) q → p = q
scope: Positive counts and at least two free levels. Fitted shape at least one and kernel scale.
dossier_scope_note: Exact shape-root comparison, uniform face and exceptional crossing are outside the theorem.

scope: Positive counts and at least two free levels. Fitted shape at least one and positive standard deviation.

statement: An attained finite two-piece Student fit at fixed shape is almost everywhere unique on a locally closed positive-width domain.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
(w : Fin n → ℕ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 2 < ν)
    (hn : 3 ≤ n) (A : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (hA : IsLocallyClosed A)
    (hwidth : ∀ p ∈ A, 0 < p.2.1 ∧ 0 < p.2.2) :
    ∀ᵐ x : Fin n → ℝ ∂volume, Function.Injective x →
      ∀ p ∈ A, ∀ q ∈ A, IsMaxOn (fun r ↦ fixedShapeLogLik w ν r x) A p →
        IsMaxOn (fun r ↦ fixedShapeLogLik w ν r x) A q → p = q
scope: Positive counts and at least three distinct free levels. Denominator-width coordinates.
dossier_scope_note: Abstract nuisance domain and finite winners only.

statement: At uniform shape and held scale, the maximizing locations are exactly the support-compatible locations.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ)
    {lam s : ℝ} (hlam : lam = 1 ∨ lam = 2) (hs : 0 < s) (m : ℝ) :
    (∃ p : Fin n → ℝ, (m, p) ∈ heldScaleGraph x lam s ∧
      IsMaxOn (graphLikelihood lam s) (heldScaleGraph x lam s) (m, p)) ↔
      ∀ j, m ∈ Icc (x j - s / lam) (x j + s / lam)
scope: Held shape one or two and positive scale.

statement: An attained finite Huber cutoff is almost everywhere unique at held location and scale.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
(w : Fin n → ℕ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hn : 0 < n)
    (m : ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    ∀ᵐ x : Fin n → ℝ ∂volume, ∀ c d : ℝ, 0 < c → 0 < d →
      IsMaxOn (fun t ↦ logLik w m s t x) (Ioi 0) c →
      IsMaxOn (fun t ↦ logLik w m s t x) (Ioi 0) d → c = d
scope: Positive counts and at least one free level.
dossier_scope_note: Pinned observations and the weighted stationary inventory are outside the theorem.

statement: An attained finite Huber cutoff is almost everywhere unique at held scale.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
(w : Fin n → ℕ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    ∀ᵐ x : Fin n → ℝ ∂volume, Function.Injective x →
      ∀ p q : ℝ × ℝ, scaleWinner w s x p → scaleWinner w s x q → p.1 = q.1
scope: Positive counts and at least three distinct free levels.
dossier_scope_note: The cutoff is unique. Multiple locations at that cutoff are possible.
